A bot that trades while you get on with your life
Five rule-based agents (not an LLM) vote on each trade of your USDC on Arc, inside a permission you can revoke in one tap. It never holds your money.
A daily USDC cap, a venue list and an end date, enforced by Arc.
Every fill floored at Chainlink’s price, on chain.
One hold stops every agent on Arc.
